Our Home

About the Apartment

Welcome to our comfortable and well-maintained apartment in the center of Trikala, Thessaly, next to the magical Elf Mill – one of the most popular Christmas destinations in Greece!

Discover the beauty of Trikala, explore Meteora and the villages of Pindos as well as other nearby attractions and enjoy your stay in a space that will make you feel at home.

Communication languages: Greek, English

Elf Mill

Christmas in Trikala

The Elf Mill is one of the most popular Christmas destinations in Greece, just a 9-minute walk from our apartment - 800 steps.

After a stroll under the lights, you return to a warm home right next to the festivities.

For the festive season we recommend asking about availability early.
